description: The enrollment exchange's two device-side wire objects, generated by net-mesh-leaf's own encoder (Stage 5) from the deterministic identity and invite below. Pinned because a wasm leaf cannot link net-mesh-sdk (the SDK depends on the core), so Stage 5 carries a deliberate mirror of InviteToken / JoinRequest / JoinOutcome from sdk/src/enrollment.rs. The enrollment exchange is the nRPC client's FIRST caller and the step that promotes a session out of PROVISIONAL: without it the anchor's §12 admission contract refuses every call, publish and announcement above the transport, and the refusal reaches the caller as a bare deadline. NOTE the pin is currently ONE-DIRECTIONAL: the core crate cannot dev-depend on the SDK, so the SDK-side half needs a test under sdk/tests/ asserting JoinRequest::from_bytes accepts `join_request_hex` and verify_self_signature() passes over it, and that InviteToken::from_bytes accepts `invite_hex`. Named in the Stage 5 report. The live cross-check that does exist is stronger than either: the browser matrix runs this exact request against the anchor's real net.mesh.enroll provider, which reconstructs the join challenge itself and rejects a single wrong byte.

identity.note: Ed25519 secret = 32 x 0x21, X25519 secret = 32 x 0x22 — the same identity capability_announcement_leaf.json uses.

invite.note: InviteToken wire form: magic NMI1, root(32), nonce(16), expires_at(u64 LE), rendezvous(u32 LE length + bytes).

join_request.note: JoinRequest wire form: magic NMJ1, device(32), invite_nonce(16), root(32), signature(64), name(lp), tag_count(u32 LE), tags(lp each). The signature is Ed25519 by `device` over join_challenge(device, name, tags, invite_nonce, root), domain-separated with the ASCII string 'net-mesh enrollment join-request v1' and length-prefixed field by field.
join_request.name: chrome-tab

join_outcome.note: JoinOutcome wire form: magic NMO1, then tag 0 Admitted + chain(lp), or tag 1 Rejected + code(u16 LE) + message(lp). Tag 0 is the only value that promotes a session; tag 1 leaves it provisional.
